pages.text: $(li)Left-click: take a stack.$(li)Right-click: take half.$(li)With cursor items: left deposits all; right deposits one.$(li)Shift-left-click storage: take a stack into inventory.$(li)Shift-click inventory: deposit.$(br2)Scroll the grid or drag its scrollbar. Items that do not fit stay put.

pages.title: Carry and place
pages.text: Place cursor items in your inventory or the crafting grid.

Search by name, ID, $(bold)@mod$(), or $(bold)#tag$(). Right-click search to clear.$(br2)The 3x3 grid refills ingredients from storage after crafting. Shift-click the result for one output stack. The return icon clears ingredients into storage.$(br2)Shift-right-click a craftable item to queue a stack. Middle-click selects an amount for the hammer button.
